An open item keeps material that corrects or narrows its own recorded scope. An instruction aimed at work an item already dispatched extends that item. A completed item is history: further work gets its own item unless the user explicitly reopens it. A user statement that a step is finished completes that item; a review remark alone extends it. A reply, receipt or delivery result shows a message moved; it does not show work finished, and a repeated source reference adds nothing to the list. A blocked item continues only when the evidence shows the named dependency changed; partial news keeps it blocked. Ask only when two existing items are equally supported.

criteria.supp:bench-dev: Extend the open item bench-dev with this material; add no second item. Its recorded scope is the dev-set benchmark, still pending.
criteria.supp:bench-run: Extend the open item bench-run with this material; add no second item. Its recorded scope is the full benchmark run.
criteria.new: Open a new item for this material; existing items keep their recorded scope and state. A third benchmark item beside the two recorded ones.
criteria.clarify: Ask which work this belongs to before writing anything. Both benchmark items are pending or running.
